reviews.review: Absolutely amazing game! I've played this game more than any others because it never gets boring. Theres always something new to do with the constant updates and such. The combat is great and the controls are awesome. It has very good graphics and is very well thought out. I would highly recommend the game to any gamers. My only problem with it was the fact that with it being a free game it has to make money and well they got the money my alot of purchases for "platinum." When you get higher up in the ranks you can get platinum by winning "prime" items which you can trade but other than that it is one of my favorite games of all time.
An awesome game! Would definitely play more if I had a PC that could actually run it better. Good job on making the game!

After playing for over three thousand hours, I created a link with the game, which is part of my life. This game has incredible graphics, a unique community, there are rare occasions where you find toxicity, on the contrary, you find many people arguing and fighting over who should help you, this is very funny ...

The graphics are insanely beautiful, with a medium or basic hardware even with a Ryzen 3 + Motherboard and 8gb of ram, it is already playable with graphics in the middle.
It has a toxic sound but it is possible to dissent in battles, although it is very difficult and needs focus. In quieter moments, I have my doubts if there is any player who disagrees that the game has a good audio.
Its soundtrack, over time has improved, it is nostalgic that even today there are traces of the old Warframe of the year 2013.

The gameplay is initially good, but it becomes very repetitive, fortunately recently with the new updates from "Open World", the loop has decreased a lot, but still has a focus on "FARM",
The game's Lore is one of the best I've seen, many don't realize it and the fact that the game forces the player to "explore" to know the lore can become frustrating, but I still think it's cool in personal opinion, a practical example are the Kurias , which tells the story of the Grineer Queens, and collecting them is very difficult.

To be honest, this game is free, and I inform anyone who, for this type of gameplay, has no comparison, Warframe is the best in that regard. Like all games, everyone has their flaws, but remember that Warframe and compare how Warframe was and what it is today, and especially, remember who developed and developed this game, congratulations to Digital Extreme and the team developer of Warframe!
